judged_text: Rewriting `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` as `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})` inverts the condition, so slug is now written when team billing is enabled instead of when it is disabled. On deployments with IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED=false (self-hosted), organizations are created with no slug at all where they previously got one, breaking org pages/links; with it enabled, orgs get slug set immediately, bypassing the requestedSlug approval flow the adjacent metadata line still implements.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts`, the diff changes `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, which reverses the condition. Previously `slug` was set when team billing was disabled; now it is set when enabled. The adjacent metadata line still conditionally sets `requestedSlug` when enabled, so writing `slug` immediately under `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` can bypass the intended requested-slug flow, and under `false` it stops writing slug at all.
